rows.grounds: adverb marking the next step in the ritual sequence
compound noun naming the rite to be performed next
optative of the root as, expressing prescription
compound noun naming the subsequent rite
adverb resuming or repeating the sequence

items.question: Which rite is prescribed immediately after vāstuhoma and before śayanārohaṇa?
items.inference: The verse prescribes kautuka-bandha before bed-ascending.
uncertainties: The exact ritual content of kautukabandha is not specified here
items.plain_english: Then there should be kautuka-bandha, and again bed-ascending.
